source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
topic: Unaccusativity diagnostics in Sakha: Causative alternation and others
notes: Another test concerns agentive nominals marked with the suffix –CI (after consonants: -AAccY) which were discussed in detail in 2.4.3. The test yields the same results as English –er nominalizations which are known to apply only to verbs with an external argument, hence they are possible from transitives and unergatives (9a) but not from unaccusatives (9b).
